notes: Product: VS Code extension copilot with streaming inline suggestions. Primary client: Kodexly IDE plugin team.
Key ask: sub-100ms median for inline completions (cursor-aware), 95th < 200ms for single-line suggestions at 32 token context.
Throughput target: 200 concurrent active devs on pilot, estimated 1500 completions/minute peak for 60-seat pilot.
Model preference: open-model family first (cost control) but must support pinned checkpoints + semantic versioning. 'We need reproducible outputs across releases', PM said.
Streaming: prefer websocket streaming + token-deltas; fallback to SSE for customers behind strict proxies.
Auth: OAuth2 for extension + org SSO (SAML) for admin provisioning; per-seat API keys for rate limiting and billing attribution.
Rate limiting: want soft quota per-seat and org-wide burst with throttled queueing; concerned about noisy devs consuming tokens.
Caching: local prefix/KV cache for common boilerplate suggested to save token cost — interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations.
Quality: working set includes JS/TS, Go snippets; they want guardrails for hallucinations in API docs completions.
Privacy: extension sends minimal telemetry; code never persisted beyond tokenization stage without explicit opt-in.
Quote from PM: 'Pilot success = sticky dev UX + 40% reduction in time-to-complete PRs for early adopters.'
